parsed.explanation: The quoted dichotomy is the essential invariant for Lemma (ii), but the text never defines the claimed parity-row evolution precisely or proves that adding the next, twice-as-tall column preserves the dichotomy under arbitrary cuts and interleavings. The phrase about “two identical copies” does not itself establish that invariant. If the second alternative were proved, the final count would follow immediately: cutting every one of the s+1 original columns requires at least s+1 cuts. But that alternative has not been rigorously derived. Since Lemma (ii) is the only argument protecting Liu’s geometric partition against every Xiang reply, the all-n lower bound remains incomplete as written.
